# Test fixtures

Responses recorded from the real APIs, so tests run against what they actually
send. Keep them as recorded: their job is to show the real shape, and a trimmed
copy would stop catching changes to it.

- `onthisday_selected_10-13.json` — Wikipedia's *On this day* feed (`selected`,
  13 October), recorded on 2026-10-13. Used by `tests/test_recorded_feed.py`.
